name: North Macedonia

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 1822612 inhabitants, recorded as 1.823 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Collected on 2026-07-28, in Macedonian, in the transversal venues pass, and it closes the case the pass of 2026-07-27 left open. Zero, and the zero is a judgement, which is why it is disputed rather than open. The population was settled first, which the earlier attempt could not do. The state agency for free access to public information publishes the list of public-institution theatres in the country, and there are twelve: the Tetovo and Gostivar theatres, the Albanian theatre, the Drama theatre, the Macedonian National Theatre, the National Theatre in Bitola, the National Opera and Ballet, the Theatre for Children and Youth, Teatar Komedija, the Turkish theatre, the Jordan Hadži Konstantinov Džinot theatre in Veles, and the Albanian theatre for children and young people. Not one of the twelve carries the word куклен in its name, and none of the general houses was found to name a puppet stage. So the whole country turns on one institution, the НУ Театар за деца и младинци in Skopje, at Dimitrija Čupovski 4, financed by the Ministry of Culture in its own words. It is the strongest case this record has yet refused. Its domain is literally puppet.com.mk. Its lineage is the national puppetry lineage: the puppet stage of the Macedonian National Theatre from 21 April 1946, independent as the City Puppet Theatre from 1949 under Lazar Balabanov, reorganised in the 1957/58 season into a youth and children's theatre playing on two stages. It keeps a куклар on the staff, it played the puppet production Тоби, and it announced a puppet project for adults made with its own funds. It is refused because none of that is a permanent puppetry unit. The theatre lists one ensemble, fourteen актери, with no puppet ensemble and no puppet stage beside it, and its own description of itself puts puppetry inside a range rather than at the centre: a broad choice of productions, куклени and играни for children, through to full-evening youth productions. That is the line Kolibri settled and it is the same shape refused in Sarajevo in this pass — a children's and youth theatre descended from a puppet theatre, playing puppetry with one mixed company. A domain name is not a structure and a puppet master is a workshop post, present in drama houses that count nothing. What would overturn this is a staff register or a founding act showing a puppetry unit inside ТДМ, and neither was reached: the Ministry of Culture's site resets the connection from here, as it refused the earlier pass, so nothing was read at the level where an establishment act would be. The value is a zero produced by applying the denominator to what the institutions publish about themselves, and it should be read as that and not as a statement that Skopje has no puppetry. It plainly has some. It has no unit.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained and, to say it plainly, no usable result: the search aimed at the faculty of dramatic arts in Skopje returned no information on a possible puppetry stream, positive or negative. The value of 0 is kept but rests on no finding at all, only on the absence of results, which is the weakest evidentiary state in this series. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1 to carry that weakness. To be redone with a query aimed at the Faculty of Dramatic Arts of Ss. Cyril and Methodius University. Estimate.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.

notes: Twelve public theatres in the country and not one named for puppets. The Theatre for Children and Youth in Skopje is the puppet theatre's successor and plays puppetry with one mixed company of fourteen.
to_check: Settle the denominator of the dates indicator before collecting anything.
Find the annual report of at least one organisation in the country.

venues: settle whether the Teatar za deca i mladinci in Skopje holds a puppetry unit or plays puppetry with its acting ensemble. Its own site names actors only; the ministry page that would say answered 503. Look also for a second Macedonian house outside Skopje, which this pass did not.
